text:
The scream, the beak, the tooth, the howls,
+
+butcher nothingness and all its racket,
+
+before this simple flower fade away.

translation.title: The Scream, the Beak, the Tooth, the Howls…
translation.editorial_note: Carnicera remains the compact compound butcher nothingness; violence and noise grammatically dissolve before the flower’s simplicity.
